implementation_checks.scope: Test actual modules, not duplicated logic. Hardware criteria still require hardware evidence.
cases: delayed polling, tick crossing and full-counter-range uptime where timing applies
dependency failures, retry state and peripheral pin routing where drivers apply
implementation_checks.execution: Provide executable test sources and a documented runner; report blocked/not run when the compatible host toolchain is unavailable.

requirements.statement: Each press of the onboard USER button shall toggle an application state.
criteria: Each detected button-press event changes the application state from its current value to its toggled value. (expected: The state is toggled after each call and returns to its initial value after two calls.)
